messages.content:
You are grading an AI assistant's answer to a question about a company handbook.

Question: If I move from GitLab Singapore Pte Ltd to GitLab Canada Corp, how do the medical insurance benefits differ in terms of coverage for specialist care and the contact method for support?
Reference answer (written from the handbook): In Singapore, specialist care requires checking the IHP Panel Clinics Directory and contacting IHP at +64 6715 9422 for cashless arrangements, while in Canada, medical support is provided through ManuLife at 1‑800‑268‑6195.

Passages the assistant was given:
"""
[GitLab Singapore Pte Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > Medical Insurance]
GitLab Singapore team members are enrolled in comprehensive medical insurance benefits through HSBC Insurance.

Coverage & Key Features

- **Hospital and Surgical** - Coverage for inpatient procedures and hospital stays
- **Major Medical** - Protection for significant medical expenses
- **Maternity** - Support for growing families
- **Outpatient General Practitioner** - Everyday medical care when you need it
- **Outpatient Specialist** - Access to specialized medical expertise
- **Dental** - Coverage for oral health needs

See the [GitLab Singapore Benefit Overview](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OxHW3FxBqSfm6P_cfZ4lZ-WMDHYC27-H/view?usp=sharing) for more details.

How to Access Specialist Care

**Step 1**: Check if your specialist is in the [IHP Panel Clinics Directory](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FO3ZpkrHGuaqooMNDUrCI62i2JQOW6vE/view?usp=sharing). Please check the IHP App for the most up to date list. 

**Step 2**:

- **If your specialist is in the panel**: Contact IHP at +64 6715 9422 before your appointment for cashless arrangement
- **If your specialist is not in the panel**: Obtain a specialist memo with diagnosis and submit with your claim through the IHP portal

IHP Portal - Your benefits hub

Access the IHP Portal to:

- Submit and track claims
- Schedule teleconsultations
- Find panel providers near you
- Request Letters of Guarantee 
- View your benefit entitlements
- Access the member hotline
- Shop the I-Health Palace marketplace
- Find helpful resources

[GitLab Canada Corp > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing Coverage > Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage]
Comprehensive health coverage through ManuLife with no cost to you. GitLab covers 100% of premiums for team members, spouses, dependents, and domestic partners.

- All GitLab Canada Corp team members
- Coverage effective from hire date
- Spouses, dependents, and domestic partners eligible

[Global Travel and Expense Policy > 1. POLICY > Approved Office Supplies List > 4.4 Reimbursement Payout Timelines]
The procedure by which reimbursable expenses are processed varies and is dependent on contributor legal status (e.g. independent contractor, Team Member) and subsidiary assignment.

- Team Members must submit their expenses through Navan.
- Expenses for GitLab Inc, GitLab Federal, GitLab Ltd (UK), GitLab BV (Belgium and Netherlands), GitLab GmbH (Germany), GitLab PTY Ltd (Australia and New Zealand), GitLab GK (Japan) GitLab LTD (Ireland), GitLab Israel Ltd., GitLab Korea Limited, GitLab Canada Corp and GitLab Singapore PTE. LTD. are reimbursed via Navan within 7 business days for the expenses within policy or after approval by the Accounts Payable team (for out of policy expenses).
- The Team Member's bank account must be set up in Navan in order for payment to complete.
- Expenses for GitLab France S.A.S and GitLab BV Finland must be submitted and approved by the Accounts Payable team (for out of policy expenses) on or before the 6th of each month to ensure it is included in the current month's payroll.
- Navan will be implementing a Batched Payment system for team members who are reimbursed directly through Navan. If you submit multiple expenses during the week, Navan will batch these expenses into one single weekly payment that will be paid out on Mondays. These payments will include all approved expenses up until the Sunday evening prior, and should hit the team member’s bank accounts on Tuesday or Wednesday.

[GitLab Singapore Pte Ltd > We've Got You Covered]
At GitLab, we believe team member benefits should be simple to understand and there when you need them. From life's big moments to everyday questions, our comprehensive coverage gives you clarity and confidence so you can focus on your work and life.
In addition to the local benefits listed below, all Singapore team members have access to the [company-wide benefits](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/) available to all team members globally.

[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > AXA PPP Medical Insurance]
GitLab provides private medical insurance through AXA PPP to support your health and wellbeing. We cover 100% of your membership costs, and you can add family members with GitLab covering 66% of their costs.

**Important:** Enrollment in the plan is not automatic. Team members must request enrollment to be covered. Team members are also responsible for any Benefit in Kind (BIK) tax that applies to this benefit. See the Benefit in Kind sections below for details.

Eligibility Requirements

- All UK-based team members
- Coverage begins from your start date
- No medical underwriting required—pre-existing conditions are covered. Current team members enrolled and new joiners to the AXA plan will have cover for treatment of pre-existing medical issues they may have had before joining, without being a member for two years or being required to have 12 consecutive months of "trouble-free" from when the condition began (pre-existing moratorium terms no longer apply).

Coverage & Key Features

[GitLab Singapore Pte Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Personal Accident Insurance]
GitLab provides company-paid Group Personal Accident Policy through Zurich at 36 X Basic Monthly Salary, min $500,000, max $3 million

Additional Protection includes:

- Ambulance cost coverage
- Emergency travel expenses
- Trauma counseling support
- See Accident Policy section of the [GitLab Singapore Benefit Overview](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OxHW3FxBqSfm6P_cfZ4lZ-WMDHYC27-H/view) for complete details
- Full policy details: [Group Personal Accident Policy](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1W1RlfSFidpvnCOHNlKlmzy_PmJqSACo9/edit)
"""

Assistant's answer:
"""
For GitLab Singapore, specialist care requires checking the IHP Panel Clinics Directory and contacting IHP at +64 6715 9422 for cashless arrangements if in-panel [1]. The provided passages for GitLab Canada do not specify details on specialist care access or a specific contact method for support, only stating that coverage is provided through ManuLife [2]. Therefore, the specific differences in specialist care procedures and support contacts cannot be fully determined from the text.
"""

First write one sentence of reasoning, then grade three things:
- correctness: "correct" if the answer states the key information in the reference answer without contradicting it (extra correct detail is fine); "partial" if it gets part of it or is vague; "incorrect" if it is wrong, contradicts the reference, or does not answer.
- refused: true if the assistant declined or said it does not know, instead of answering.
- faithful: true if every factual claim in the answer is supported by the passages above (ignore whether it matches the reference). An answer that only refuses counts as faithful.
The grades must agree with your reasoning.
Return JSON with the reasoning first: {"reason": "one sentence", "correctness": "correct" | "partial" | "incorrect", "refused": true/false, "faithful": true/false}
